description: This PHP file defines an API endpoint class for checking punch-in record overlaps during editing in an attendance management system. It includes methods for handling GET requests, validating parameters, and computing UTC times based on input offsets and dates. The class extends a base Endpoint and implements resource endpoint functionalities, utilizing traits for authentication, attendance services, and date/time helpers.

classes.name: AttendanceEditPunchInRecordOverlapAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for checking punch-in record overlaps during editing, handling GET requests, parameter validation, and UTC time calculation based on offsets.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to check if a punch-in record overlaps with existing records during editing. Retrieves record, verifies access, calculates UTC times, and checks for overlaps.

methods.name: getUTCTimeByOffsetAndDateTime
methods.description: Computes UTC DateTime objects for punch-in and punch-out times based on provided date, time, and timezone offsets.
